mapper.select: select count(1) from DATA_SOURCE ds where ds.ID = #{dataSourceId} and ( #{admin} = true or ds.USER_ID = #{userId} or exists( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS pa where pa.ACCESS_OBJECT_TYPE = 'USER' and pa.ACCESS_OBJECT_ID = #{userId} and pa.PROJECT_ID = ds.PROJECT_ID and ( not exists ( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT pae0 where pae0.PROJECT_ACCESS_ID = pa.ID ) or exists ( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT pae where pae.PROJECT_ACCESS_ID = pa.ID and pae.ENVIRONMENT_ID = ds.ENVIRONMENT_ID ) ) ) or exists ( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS pa left join TEAM_USER tu on tu.TEAM_ID = pa.ACCESS_OBJECT_ID and pa.ACCESS_OBJECT_TYPE = 'TEAM' left join TEAM t on t.id = tu.TEAM_ID where tu.USER_ID = #{userId} and pa.PROJECT_ID = ds.PROJECT_ID and t.STATUS = 'VALID' and ( not exists ( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT pae0 where pae0.PROJECT_ACCESS_ID = pa.ID ) or exists ( select 1 from PROJECT_ACCESS_ENVIRONMENT pae where pae.PROJECT_ACCESS_ID = pa.ID and pae.ENVIRONMENT_ID = ds.ENVIRONMENT_ID ) ) ) )
